title: RunService.Heartbeat
summary: Fires every frame AFTER physics, on both client and server, passing deltaTime (seconds since last frame). The default home for per-frame logic: timers, custom movement, throttling.

details.heading: Position in the frame
details.body: Stepped → physics simulation → Heartbeat → (client: RenderStepped) → render. Heartbeat sees post-physics state.

explanation.whatItIs: The metronome of your game logic — one tick per frame, with the tick length in seconds.
explanation.whyItExists: Time-based behavior needs a reliable per-frame pulse that knows how much time actually passed.
whenToUse: AI decision ticks (with internal rate limiting)
whenNotToUse: As a substitute for task.wait in simple delays
tips: ALWAYS scale by deltaTime or behavior depends on FPS
Disconnect when done — Heartbeat connections accumulate
Keep the handler cheap: it runs every single frame
commonMistakes: Connecting per-spawn without disconnecting per-death — listener leak
Doing heavy work every frame instead of accumulating time and acting every N seconds

examples.title: Cooldown timer with dt
examples.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local cooldown = 0

local function useAbility()
    if cooldown > 0 then return false end
    cooldown = 5   -- seconds
    return true
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if cooldown > 0 then
        cooldown = math.max(0, cooldown - dt)
    end
end)
